title: How to Convert Thunderbird Emails to Outlook?
creator: shiv2expert
content:
To convert Thunderbird emails to Outlook, you must transfer messages from Thunderbird’s MBOX format into Outlook’s PST format. The most reliable free approach uses Mozilla Thunderbird and classic Outlook combined with a free IMAP email account (like Gmail or Outlook.com) to sync the data through the cloud.

Method 1: The Free IMAP Sync Method (Recommended) This approach bypasses file conversion entirely by using an email server as a temporary bridge to move messages between the two applications.

    1. Phase 1: Set Up Your Bridge Account 
  1. Create a free Gmail or Outlook.com account if you do not already have one.   2. Log into the account via your web browser, go to settings, and ensure IMAP is enabled.
    1. Phase 2: Connect the Account to Thunderbird 
  1. Open Thunderbird. Click the Menu icon (three horizontal lines) > Account Settings.   2. Click Account Actions at the bottom left, then choose Add Mail Account.   3. Enter your temporary email credentials and follow the prompts to complete the IMAP setup.
    1. Phase 3: Copy Emails to the IMAP Folders 
  1. In Thunderbird, locate your local folders or the old email account you want to move.   2. Right-click your temporary IMAP account name in the left panel and click New Folder (name it "Transfer").   3. Go to your Thunderbird source folder, select the emails (Ctrl + A), right-click them, and select Copy To > [Your Temporary Account] > Transfer.   4. Wait for Thunderbird to upload all the messages to the cloud server.
    1. Phase 4: Sync into Microsoft Outlook 
  1. Open Microsoft Outlook on your computer.   2. Go to File > Add Account and add the exact same temporary IMAP email address.   3. Once the account syncs, locate the "Transfer" folder.   4. Select all the emails inside it and drag them into your primary Outlook Inbox or your Outlook Local PST folders. 
Method 2: Drag-and-Drop EML Conversion (For Small Batches)

If you only need to move a few dozen emails, you can export them as .eml files, which Outlook can open natively. 

  1. Create a new, empty folder on your Windows Desktop (name it "Mail").   2. Open Thunderbird, select the emails you want to convert, and drag them directly out of Thunderbird into your desktop "Mail" folder. They will save automatically as .eml files.   3. Open Microsoft Outlook.   4. Create a new folder inside Outlook where you want these emails to live.   5. Select all the .eml files from your Windows desktop folder and drag them directly into the middle panel of your new Outlook folder.

Method 3: Automated MBOX to PST Converters (For Large Mailboxes) If you have multiple gigabytes of data or complex folder structures, manual sync methods can crash or time out. IT professionals typically use specialized desktop conversion software for this task. 

  1. Locate your MBOX files: In Thunderbird, go to Help > Troubleshooting Information > Profile Folder > Open Folder. Navigate to the Mail/Local Folders directory to find your mailbox databases (files with no extension, like Inbox or Sent).    2. Use a professional utility: Tools like Recoveryfix MBOX to PST Converter that allow you to browse directly to that Thunderbird Profile folder.   3. Export directly: The tool safely parses the MBOX database structures and outputs a clean, unified .pst file that you can open instantly in Outlook via File > Open & Export > Open Outlook Data File.
